en: Conditioned by a state that is neither associated with the taints (*āsava*) nor unwholesome, a state that is dissociated from the taints and wholesome arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. One [condition] under root; ... pe ... one under non-disappearance.

Conditioned by a state that is neither associated with the taints nor unwholesome, a state that is associated with the taints and unwholesome arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three [conditions] under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is neither associated with the taints nor indeterminate, there arises a state dissociated from the taints and indeterminate by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. There are three [answers] for root, three for predominance … pe … three for non-disappearance.
